description: This PHP source file defines the class Base64Attachment which handles validation of Base64 encoded file attachments, including checking allowed types, extensions, filename lengths, file size, and content integrity based on Base64 decoding.

classes.name: Base64Attachment
classes.description: A validation rule class for verifying Base64-encoded file attachments, including type, extension, filename length, size, and content verification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validation rule with allowed types, extensions, filename length limits, size constraints, and size strictness flag.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the input array containing file info, checking required fields, allowed types and extensions, filename length, size constraints, and content integrity.

methods.name: validateMin
methods.description: Checks if the filename length meets the minimum length requirement.

methods.name: validateMax
methods.description: Checks if the filename length does not exceed the maximum length.
